description: This file defines an internal interface IUnderlyingTransportFeature and a class UnderlyingConnectionTransportFeature that implements this interface, related to managing underlying transport for connections in Orleans Networking.

classes.name: UnderlyingConnectionTransportFeature
classes.description: A class that holds a transport object implementing IDuplexPipe, representing the underlying transport used by a connection.

methods.name: Transport (getter and setter)
methods.description: Property to get or set the underlying transport (IDuplexPipe).
